jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

Step into a unique opportunity to build and lead the Legal function of one of the Nordics' fastest-growing digital infrastructure companies.

**Build the Legal Function During an Important Phase of Growth

**Are you a commercially minded legal executive who thrives at the intersection of business, strategy, and law?

atNorth is a leading Nordic provider of sustainable data centre infrastructure, supporting some of the world's most demanding AI, high-performance computing, and digital workloads. Backed by leading international investors and operating across the Nordics, the company is entering an exciting new phase of growth and expansion.

To support this journey, atNorth is looking for a General Counsel to establish and lead the company's Legal function.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will become a trusted advisor to senior leadership, the Board, and investors, while playing a key role in some of the company's most important strategic and commercial decisions. This is a rare opportunity to build a function from the ground up and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing international business.

**A Strategic Leadership Role

**As General Counsel, you will have overall responsibility for legal matters across Commercial, Land & Power, and Corporate. You will support major customer contracts, infrastructure investments, financing activities, strategic partnerships, governance, and compliance while helping the business balance growth opportunities with effective risk management.

Beyond the legal agenda, you will act as a strategic business partner and contribute actively to company strategy, expansion plans, and value creation initiatives across the organisation.

**Your Profile

**You are a highly experienced legal leader with significant experience as a General Counsel, Deputy General Counsel, Associate General Counsel, or in a similarly senior legal leadership role. You have operated at executive level and are a credible, trusted advisor to CEOs, senior leadership teams, Boards, and investors.

Your background includes leading complex commercial negotiations and legal matters across several disciplines, such as commercial contracts, corporate governance, compliance, financing, and infrastructure-related matters. Experience from data centres, digital infrastructure, energy, utilities, telecommunications, construction, or another asset-intensive industry would be highly relevant.

To succeed, you must be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a complex, fast-moving environment. You combine strong legal expertise with commercial judgement and a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, and you have the ability to build legal capabilities, frameworks, and teams that support growth and long-term value creation.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Build and lead the Legal function

• Support strategic commercial negotiations and transactions

• Advise on land, power, and infrastructure projects across multiple jurisdictions

• Establish governance, compliance, and risk management frameworks

• Manage external legal counsel and key legal partnerships

• Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors

• Build and develop the future Legal team

**About The AtNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate. We don't just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced. We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging. At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together

**Apply now!

**The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with the consulting company Compass Human Resources Group. If you need further information about the position, please contact Senior Research Consultant Rebecca Saks on rs@compasshrg.com. All enquiries will be handled with confidentiality. Applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. Therefore, we ask you to apply as soon as possible to make sure that your application is taken into consideration.

Workplace: Any Nordic atNorth location, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland and Iceland

Start date: As soon as possible

Sparrow Quantum is seeking a talent acquisition and HR partner to lead recruitment and grow into a broader HR role

• Type: Permanent, full-time position

• Compensation: According to qualifications

• Location: Copenhagen

• Start date: February 1, 2027 (flexible)

• Reports to: VP of Finance

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• Competitive salary + company paid pension

• DSB Business Card

• Private health insurance

• Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• Lunch subsidized by the company

• Company phone and company credit card

• Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter in English via our website: https://sparrowquantum.com/position?id=8695575

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

**Senior Engineer, Product Development – Product Simulation

****VELUX – Products & Innovation, LKR Innovation House, Østbirk

****Do you want to influence the next generation of roof window solutions through advanced product development with a special focus on simulation?

****Join VELUX and help shape innovative products that improve everyday living through daylight and fresh air.

****Meet your future team

**You will join the New Sloped Roof Windows Platforms area, where we develop scalable and high-performing roof window solutions for the future. Working closely with colleagues across Product Development, Engineering, and Category Management, we transform customer, market, business, and regulatory needs into innovative products and solutions.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting product development through simulation-driven insights that enable robust design decisions, product optimisation, and engineering excellence.

**What We Offer

**As Senior Engineer, Product Development – Product Simulation, you will contribute to developing future product platforms by applying your simulation expertise throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Your key responsibilities will include:

**

• Translating product requirements into simulation and validation activities.

• Providing technical recommendations based on data-driven analyses and simulation results.

• Collaborating with design engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure robust and reliable solutions.

• Supporting verification and validation activities throughout the development process.

**You are a curious and analytical engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and collaborating across disciplines. You take a structured approach to your work and communicate technical findings in a clear and constructive way.

• Preferable have touched upon dynamic simulation and CFD

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are comfortable working in a cross-functional and international environment.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• Are motivated by continuous improvement and innovation.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group at www.velux.com.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously until the position is filled.

All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**At the VELUX Group, we create healthier indoor environments for people around the world by bringing daylight and fresh air into homes and buildings. We are an international, family-owned company with strong values, a long-term perspective, and a commitment to making a positive impact on society, our employees, and the planet.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected, supported, and able to contribute their best. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, identity, experiences, or perspectives. We believe diversity strengthens innovation and helps us create better solutions for our customers and colleagues worldwide.

Field Service Electronics Engineer

Join ChemoMetec and be a part of our next-generation technology

• Support customers on site in the Asia-Pacific region when needed.

• Service electromechanical systems, including firmware updates and module and component replacement.

• Inspect instruments and setups to identify and reduce risks that could lead to downtime, and read and troubleshoot system-generated log files.

• Work closely with R&D, Product Management and the service organization at our headquarters to share field insights and contribute to continuous product improvement.

What We’re Looking For

We’re searching for someone who thrives on solving complex problems and enjoys travelling to meet customers in their own environments. To succeed in this role, you have:

• 2+ years of field service experience, ideally with electromechanical laboratory equipment or automation systems.

• Strong knowledge of sensors, actuators, firmware interaction and basic networking.

• A curious mind and a real passion for technology.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**

At ChemoMetec, you’ll be part of a growing life science company driven by innovation and a strong sense of purpose. We offer:

• A key role in the launch of our new XcytoMatic product line, shaping the future of automated cell counting.

• Thorough training and onboarding at our headquarters in Allerød.

• A supportive and highly skilled team of engineers and scientists.

• Opportunities to grow professionally in an international company with a strong focus on quality and technology.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

**

Practical information**

When you’re not travelling, you’ll be based at our headquarters in Allerød, Denmark, and will report to Tobias Schaldemose, Head of Operations US. The starting date is as soon as possible.

Please submit your CV and a short cover letter via our website. We’ll review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to reach out to tsc@chemometec.com.

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

**Working at Ørsted

**In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

**Your Skills

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

• Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

• Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.

• Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).

• Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**

• Deliver profitable, on-time project execution across the global Crushing portfolio.

• Lead proposal development, bid governance, commercial risk management and execution planning.

• Establish world-class execution processes, governance and performance management.

The Danish and Icelandic Affiliate | Novo

Are you passionate about building partnerships that can shape the future of healthcare? Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to turn emerging opportunities into sustainable solutions for patients and the business?

We are looking for a Senior Manager in Partnerships to join the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate to help identify, develop and drive business growth through strategic partnerships.

What you’ll bring

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a solid understanding of IT integrations and a talent for creating structure, progress and strong working relationships?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a hands-on Technical Project Manager to support a major global transformation programme involving the implementation of new systems, global processes and data migration.

The programme implements a new Transportation Management System (TMFF), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and a Vendor Invoice Management solution (Basware and AP Essentials.

As Technical Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving and coordinating integration projects across teams, integration specialists and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to create structure, draft plans, ensure progress and make sure that tasks, responsibilities, dependencies and deadlines are clearly defined and followed up.

You will act as the link between diverse teams and the business, helping translate technical challenges into clear business requirements – and vice versa.

This is not a developer role. However, you should have a good technical understanding of integrations, data flows and system dependencies, enabling you to engage confidently in technical discussions and challenge proposed solutions when needed.

You should also enjoy getting involved in the practical aspects of project management, including communication, documentation, process descriptions and mapping integration flows. It is a must that you know when to support and when to drive tasks, content, colleagues to ensure progress.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and coordinate integration projects across implementation and integration teams and vendor teams, i.e., integration to e-invoicing governmental portals

• Act as the link between technical teams, system owners, implementation teams and business stakeholders.

• Create structure, clear priorities, realistic timelines and well-defined project plans.

• Ensure proper task management and follow-up in Jira.

• Make sure tasks are clearly described, assigned to the right people and followed through to completion. You support the integration team with describing their tasks, flow descriptions, etc.

• Coordinate resources, dependencies and delivery schedules across teams.

• Support the documentation of integration flows, system dependencies and processes.

• Translate technical issues into business requirements and ensure alignment between business and IT.

• Follow up on progress, identify bottlenecks and help resolve issues before they impact delivery.

• Coordinate testing, deployment and operational handover where relevant.

Your background

We are looking for someone with solid experience in technical project management and, in particular, system integration projects.

You do not need to be a technical specialist or developer, but you must understand how systems communicate and how integrations work.

Ideally, you have:

• Experience managing IT integration projects.

• A good understanding of APIs, CSV, data flows and integration patterns.

• An understanding of system dependencies and how different applications interact.

• Experience coordinating technical teams, developers or integration specialists.

• Experience with project planning, resource coordination, and delivery follow-up.

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.

• The ability to create clear documentation, process descriptions and integration flow diagrams.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ERP or TMS solutions is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from logistics and transportation is also an advantage, but we are equally interested in candidates from finance, operations or other industries who have moved into IT and integration projects.

Who are you?

Your personality will be just as important as your technical and project management experience.

You are someone who can create momentum and gain the respect of others without relying on formal management authority.

You are structured, detail-oriented and persistent when it comes to following up and ensuring that things get done.

At the same time, you are approachable and understand the importance of building good relationships.

You are comfortable working with different personalities, handling disagreements and challenging existing ways of working in a constructive manner.

You know when to push and when to listen. You can stand your ground without being overly dominant, and you understand that successful project delivery depends on bringing people along.

You are pragmatic, have a good sense of humour and can navigate different situations with confidence and good judgement.

The team

You will report to the Programme Lead and work closely with integration specialists, system owners, workstream leads, implementation project managers and solution architects to mention just a few.

What we offer

• An important role in a major global transformation programme.

• An international working environment with colleagues across different countries.

• A role combining technical insight, project management and relationship building.

• The opportunity to make a visible difference to project delivery and collaboration.

Location: Hvidovre is preferred, but Viby is also an option for the right candidate.

**Travel:**Approximately once a month between locations.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

**Want to own outcomes, not just output?

**At PriceShape, we’re looking for a Product Manager who cares less about whether something shipped and more about whether it worked.

We’re strengthening our product organisation, and you’ll join at a stage where you can influence not only what we build, but how we build it. Together with our Head of Product, designers and engineers, you’ll help create solutions that make a measurable difference for our customers and our business.

**About The Role

**As our Product Manager, your job is to make sure what we build reaches customers, gets used, and moves a number we care about.

You’ll work as part of a Product Trio with a designer and a tech lead, as peers throughout discovery and delivery. You bring the view of the customer and the business; they bring design and technical expertise. Together, you decide what to build.

We believe great product management is about understanding why something matters, making decisions based on evidence and learning from what works – and what doesn’t. Shipping a feature is not the finish line. The outcome moving is.

**What You’ll Be Doing

****Understand our customers and market

**

• Make direct customer contact a weekly habit, not an intention.

• Identify customer challenges, unmet needs and where our product falls short today.

• Know our competitive landscape well enough to say where we’re better, where we’re worse and what has quietly become table stakes.

• Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to turn customer feedback into well-understood problems, not a list of requests.

**Drive measurable outcomes

**

• Agree your team’s outcomes each quarter with the Head of Product, and define how success is measured.

• Decide which opportunities your team pursues, based on customer value, business impact and evidence.

• Test the riskiest assumptions first, and test them cheaply.

• Work directly with product data to understand whether an outcome actually moved.

**Build great products together

**

• Bring engineers and designers into the problem early, where they add the most value.

• Give the team the context it needs to make good decisions without you in the room: the strategy, the customer, the constraints and why it matters now.

• Resolve disagreements by testing assumptions, not by rank.

**Connect Product with the Business

**

• Build strong relationships across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Data & AI.

• Keep commercial teams informed on what’s changed, what’s coming next – and what’s no longer coming, and why.

• Treat pricing, packaging, legal and data protection as product questions to understand early, not afterthoughts.

**What This Role Is Not

****We write this down deliberately, because each of these has been called product management somewhere:

**

• Not a backlog administrator. A backlog that’s always ready is not the measure of this job.

• Not a project manager. Project managers answer for when. This role answers for why, and for whether it worked.

• Not an order taker. Requests from stakeholders and customers are input, not instructions.

• Not the boss of the team. No one reports to this role. Your authority comes from evidence and judgment.

**Help shape the future of Product at PriceShape

**As AI and agents take on more of the building, the constraint shifts. We’ll be able to build more, faster – including more of the wrong things. That makes good product decisions more valuable than ever.

Over time, this role will move from reviewing individual pieces of work towards encoding judgment: personas, product principles and experiment frameworks that help the team make good decisions without needing to be gated. You’ll help shape what that looks like here.

**What We’re Looking For

**You enjoy getting close to customers, asking questions and challenging assumptions. You’re comfortable making decisions based on evidence, and equally comfortable deferring when someone else holds the relevant expertise.

You don’t need to have all the answers. What matters is your ability to ask the right questions, bring people together and turn insight into results.

**We Imagine You Bring

**

• Experience working as a Product Manager, preferably within B2B SaaS.

• Hands-on experience with product discovery, customer interviews and assumption testing.

• A track record of working towards measurable outcomes rather than simply delivering features.

• Confidence working directly with product data.

• Experience working as a peer with engineering and design.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to give straight answers about what is and isn’t coming.

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have

**

• Experience within pricing, e-commerce, retail or brands.

• Experience with data-heavy products, where the product is the data itself.

• Familiarity with SQL or product analytics tools.

• Experience with or a genuine interest in how AI is changing product work.

You don’t need to tick every box. If you recognise yourself in the role, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**

• Real ownership: Accountability for meaningful outcomes, with the mandate to say no and to stop things.

• A chance to shape something: Help establish how our product organisation works as it grows.

• Empowered collaboration: Work as a peer with designers and engineers, and closely with our commercial teams.

• Support and development: Regular coaching and feedback from our Head of Product.

• Room to experiment: An environment where curiosity, testing and learning are expected.

• An international workplace: Colleagues from 25+ nationalities across disciplines and markets.

• Flexibility and balance: Flexible working hours, social activities, pension, health insurance and modern offices in Aarhus and Stockholm.

**About PriceShape

**PriceShape is an international SaaS company headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark. Our platform helps retailers and brands make smarter pricing decisions through competitor tracking, pricing intelligence and automation, enabling them to increase revenue and profitability.

With around 80 colleagues from over 25 nationalities, we serve customers in more than 25 countries. We’re ambitious about where we’re going, and we’re continuously developing our products, our organisation and the way we work.

**Ready to apply?

**If you want to build products that solve real customer problems – and care about whether they actually did – we’d love to hear from you.

Apply by submitting your CV. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Per Mellqvist at pm@priceshape.com.

New Power Partners is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex construction and building projects across Europe.

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by:

• Safe and successful project delivery.

• High client satisfaction and repeat business.

• Strong financial and commercial project performance.

• Development of new business opportunities.

• Contribution to the growth of the project management team and the wider business.

Why join New Power Partners?

You will work in an international project environment, collaborate with experienced colleagues and customers, and play a role in shaping the future of Site Solutions.

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Project Manager who enjoys delivering complex projects, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the growth of both the business and future project teams**.

**Job Description

**Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

Mercedes-Benz is on an exciting journey of transformation. By combining pioneering products and services with a strong customer focus, we continue to set new standards in safety, digitalization and design.

To strengthen our Danish used-car business, we are now looking for an analytical and commercially minded Used Car Specialist. The position is based at our office at Digevej, Copenhagen. You will be a part of a team across border and expect to travel to our Swedish office, based in Hyllie Malmö, on a regular basis.

**About The Position

**As Used Car Specialist, you will play an important role in driving our used car and remarketing activities in Denmark together with the team. You will combine commercial insight, data analysis and operational coordination to help ensure competitive pricing and efficient vehicle sales. Working closely with dealers, auction and remarketing partners, as well as Sales and other internal stakeholders, you will turn market data into clear recommendations and help create a professional, efficient vehicle journey from return to sale.

**

• Drive remarketing performance by analyzing sales, stock, pricing and market data and translating insights into commercial action.

• Own the remarketing journey from returned to sale.

• Enable high-quality vehicle sales by securing accurate documentation, equipment descriptions and vehicle data.

• Build strong partnerships with Danish dealers, auction platforms, logistics providers and other remarketing partners.

• Support the team in improving processes, reporting and data quality across the remarketing journey.

**You are analytical, structured and curious about understanding what drives business performance. You enjoy working with data and figures, but also appreciate collaborating with colleagues, dealers and external partners.

You are proactive, detail-oriented and motivated to learn new skills in a dynamic commercial environment.

**We believe you bring:

• Solid Excel skills and the ability to work with large datasets.

• Commercial understanding, combined with a structured and quality-conscious approach.

Are you the person who keeps a team moving and turns customer needs into clear decisions? At Playable, we help some of the world’s biggest brands bring playable marketing into their strategy, adding interactive experiences that audiences actually want to engage with. We’re looking for a Product Manager to work side by side with our VP of Product and be the link between the people who ask for things and the engineers who build them.

The role

You drive the day-to-day work around the roadmap: planning, priorities and follow-up. You make sure things get done. Planning is at the heart of it: the quarterly roadmap, what goes into each sprint, and what can wait. You keep us delivering on it while handling customer requests and ad-hoc needs without losing the thread. You work hands-on with the VP of Product to shape that roadmap, with room to take on more of it over time.

Our customers are marketers at enterprise brands, and they push the platform in new directions all the time. Your job is to make sure the best of those ideas make it into the product, and that the rest get a clear and honest “not now”.

The role includes

• Planning the quarterly roadmap with the VP of Product, and deciding what goes into each sprint

• Running day-to-day product operations: Jira, backlog, priorities and status

• Being the contact for customer feedback and roadmap questions between Customer Success, Sales and the development team, gathering requirements and keeping everyone updated

• Sparring with developers on scope and “how should this work?”, so the team gets clear answers and knows what matters most, and why

• Collecting and sorting customer requests and feedback, and speaking for the end user, both the marketers who build campaigns and the people who play them

• Following projects from idea to release, including reviews and up-to-date documentation

• Communicating progress and what’s coming, including the roadmap, to the team and the wider organisation

The ideal profile

• You’re structured, reliable and good with details, and you finish what you start. You like a fast pace and don’t need everything to be perfectly defined before you get going.

• Experience with product or project management in a software or SaaS team

• Comfortable working closely with developers

• You bring structure that helps the team move faster, not slower

• Customer-focused: you can turn what customers say into clear requirements and decisions the team can build from

• You can prioritise, say no, and explain why

• Clear communicator in English (Danish is a plus)

• A plus: experience with B2B SaaS, martech or enterprise customers

Let's put play to work

At Playable, we use the power of play to connect leading brands with consumers around the world – and change the game for ambitious marketers everywhere. Our flexible SaaS platform allows our customers to integrate playable marketing in all stages driving engagement.

While we have grown quickly, our success is fuelled by a work culture centred around what matters most to us: All the great people who make up our culture – and who make it all possible. Together, we’re here to do great work – and to have fun doing it. Because, every second of every day, people around the globe play our games, and we believe this is just the beginning. So, come join us and let’s put play to work.

Your mission

As our Carbon Removal Supply Lead, a new role here at Klimate, you will build and own the systems, data, and market intelligence of our carbon supply sourcing. You will strengthen sourcing as a function and enable strategic and commercial decision-making grounded in strong supplier relationships, accurate market information, and well-governed internal data.

You will sit within the Sourcing team and report directly to Matt Averna, Head of Markets & Policy.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Storebrand, Dalberg, OC&C, and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What you'll do

In the first 3–6 months, you will:

• Become fluent in Klimate’s sourcing priorities, supplier base, and contracting approach for carbon removal projects.

• Independently prepare for and contribute to supplier meetings, using structured data and clear market context.

• Support and share responsibility of supplier meetings, preparing materials and ensuring learnings are captured in internal systems.

• Manage projects and contracts in Klimate’s administrative inventory system, coordinating with internal stakeholders where needed.

• Take ownership of existing supplier and project data across sourcing systems, ensuring it is well structured, consistent, and up-to-date.

As you grow into the role, you will:

• Own the ongoing development and governance of Klimate’s sourcing database, ensuring it reliably supports day-to-day sourcing and strategic decision-making.

• Generate regular, data-driven market and commercial insights (e.g. pricing, geographies, project categories, contracting terms) to inform sourcing focus and prioritisation.

• Actively manage supplier relationships in collaboration with sourcing leadership, ensuring accurate management in our data systems.

• Execute contracting of carbon removal purchase agreements with structured inputs from market data and supplier interactions.

• Serve as a sparring partner to sourcing leadership and relevant internal teams on sourcing focus, market coverage, and portfolio construction.

**Requirements & Skills

**

Must-have

• Relevant work experience in carbon markets, climate tech, energy markets, or a closely related sourcing or market analysis field.

• Pre-existing experience working with carbon market supply, ideally in an intermediary or transaction-oriented role with broad market exposure.

• Strong understanding of commercial terms and contracting logic, and comfort engaging with complex contract language and deal structures.

• High data literacy, with experience designing, maintaining, and working with structured databases or admin systems (tool-agnostic).

• Comfort working at the intersection of supplier engagement, market analysis, and data operations, combining people-centric soft skills with quantitative ability.

• Ability to take ownership of complex, evolving problem spaces, translating high-level objectives into pragmatic execution.

Nice-to-have

• Direct experience with carbon removal projects or technologies.

• Experience producing external-facing market reports, briefs, or thought leadership content.

• Familiarity with policy or subsidy mechanisms relevant to carbon markets.

• Experience collaborating with product, sales, or digital teams on data or systems integration.

Who you are

• You are highly analytical and value data as the basis for decision-making.

• You are comfortable working independently within a coaching-oriented management style, translating broad direction into concrete actions.

• You proactively identify opportunities for improvement and propose ideas, analyses, or new ways of structuring work.

• You are curious, and motivated by bringing clarity and order to complex or fragmented information.

• You are comfortable representing Klimate externally in supplier conversations while grounding discussions in facts, data, and commercial logic.

What we offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits
